question: Should ClawSweeper officially support Claude CLI as a first-class alternative runtime for every model-backed automation lane, including its provider credential and operational support commitment?
rationale: This PR adds a broad operator-facing runtime mode and several cloud-provider credential paths; correctness tests cannot decide the long-term supported surface, security posture, or maintenance commitment.

options.title: Adopt the runtime contract
options.body: Approve Claude as a supported runtime, subject to narrowing credential exposure and completing authenticated provider smoke proof.

options.title: Limit the initial scope
options.body: Support only one Claude provider or selected lanes first, reducing credential and operational surface before broad rollout.

options.title: Keep Codex-only execution
options.body: Decline the new runtime mode and retain the current Codex-only workflow contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the runtime contract
recommendation.body: Approve Claude as a supported runtime, subject to narrowing credential exposure and completing authenticated provider smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current runtime and provider design and are the known member connected to the proposed operational contract.
